established: Complete parent hit4 copies original owner/origin/skill/rank into each positive HitSubMissile creation attempt. Optional immediate child hit dispatch occurs only after successful creation and positive parent sHitPar1; current Exploding Arrow row has0.

Complete child hit1 obtains one declared damage packet, adds row flags and invokes the shared area delivery at child coordinates. Positive row radius overrides skill formula; nonpositive row radius evaluates a clamped minimum1 skill radius. Missing missile/record/owner/required skill exits without damage.

Complete area delivery uses default filter0x8583. Each recipient callback copies the original prepared packet before complete per-target block/dodge/result/event/missile routing. A deliberately destructive downstream stub cannot contaminate the next recipient; flagged successful/unblocked events remain individual.
limits: World recipient enumeration, formula/stat/damage getter, factory allocation, critical and final damage/event services are explicit adapters. This establishes callback ordering/data flow, not modern collision/factory/damage channel inheritance or live-engine equivalence.

Parent versus child physical/item-fire/skill-fire, weapon events, source sentinels, creation-time versus impact-time modifiers, wall/lifetime/AlwaysExplode/child scheduling/Pierce and actual current behavior remain to establish before a handler is enabled. No independent per-recipient damage reroll is introduced by the compiled callbacks.
